author: Anna Szymanski
text:
Sept 11 (Reuters) - Looking for inspiration? Every Friday, Weekend Reads rounds up what the Reuters ​Open Interest team has been reading, watching and listening ‌to.
This week's picks span data integrity, China's decarbonisation push, AI-powered oilfields and more.
This weekend, we're reading...
MIKE DOLAN, ROI Finance & Markets Columnist: This important piece by Jed Kolko ​at the Peterson Institute for International Economics
, opens new tab
 in Washington examines the ​corrosive effect of political meddling in official government data.
GAVIN ⁠MAGUIRE, ROI Global Energy Transition Columnist: UK think tank Ember's latest analysis
, opens new tab
 tracks ​China's progress in reducing fossil-fuel dependence across its most energy-intensive sectors. It's ​a must-read for anyone interested in the global engine of industrial production, carbon emissions and green tech.
ANDY HOME, ROI Metals Columnist: This OECD report
, opens new tab
 explores the issue ​of traceability in critical minerals, which is essential for creating resilient ​supply chains. The report assesses the current state of play as well as ‌the ⁠challenges that lie ahead, focusing on lithium in Argentina and Chile as well as nickel in Indonesia and the Philippines.
We're listening to...
RON BOUSSO, ROI Energy Columnist: In this podcast from the Oxford Institute for Energy Studies
, opens new tab
, ​director Bassam Fattouh ​and energy analyst ⁠Paul Horsnell explore changes in oil trading practices since the collapse of the June 17 U.S.-Iranian ceasefire.
​And we're watching...
CLYDE RUSSELL, ROI Asia Commodities and ​Energy ⁠Columnist: This episode of the "Digital Innovations in Oil and Gas" podcast from consultant Geoffrey Cann
, opens new tab
 looks at how AI can transform the management and maintenance of ⁠oilfields.
